title: Hunts FH-021: Build inventory and award transaction

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 2, Rewards. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Define deterministic reward specs, eligibility, inventory, available grants and optional adapter. Done when: Two qualifying players racing last reward allocate one, while losing response honors published stock terms. Requires: FH-009, FH-010, FH-020. Owner role: Database and economy.
